messages:
marta-s: spotted 3 snapshots in gs://redwood-prod-backups/ that lack kmsKeyName metadata — noticed during our daily backup audit.
kai-infra: yikes. which objects? any idea when they were uploaded?
anil-sre: audit log shows objectCreate at 2109876401, 2109876420, 2109876502. principal: deploy-bot@redwood did a SetIamPolicy earlier; looks like an IAM change touched the snap-writer SA.
jenna-custsec: snap-writer should never have broad storage roles. was there a terraform/role change merged?
audit-bot: [alert] 2109876600 CMEK_MISSING_ON_OBJECTS count=3 project=redwood-prod link=https://console.audit.redwood/alerts/512
oliver-md: paste the IAM diff please so we can see what policy was applied.
anil-sre: log snippet: CloudAudit protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" principalEmail="deploy-bot@redwood" resource="projects/infra/serviceAccounts/snap-writer@redwood.iam" policyDelta.addedBindings=[{"role":"roles/storage.admin","members":["serviceAccount:ops-oncall@redwood"]}]
kai-infra: deploy-bot ran the rollout for infra-roles PR #482 about 4h ago. that PR changed role composition for several SAs. reverting the specific binding now.
marta-s: immediate actions: 1) revoke storage.admin from snap-writer, 2) add detection rule to flag any backup object without kmsKeyName, 3) plan server-side re-encrypt for the three objects, 4) rotate deploy-bot creds.
jenna-custsec: also need to check restore logs in case anyone restored from these objects. if restores happened, escalations for customers.
anil-sre: grep on restore logs for those object names -> no matches in 30d. running checksum verifies after rewrite.
oliver-md: recommended re-encrypt approach: server-side rewrite with CMEK to avoid egress and preserve metadata. example command:
```
gsutil rewrite -k projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/backup/cryptoKeys/backup-cmek-v2 gs://redwood-prod-backups/snap-2026-03-20-abc123.snap
```
marta-s: confirm we can script that and run with limited concurrency. add backoff for 503s.
kai-infra: rolled back IAM change and revoked deploy-bot token at 2109876705. also pushed PR #501 to create a least-privileged custom role for snap-writer (only storage.objects.create, storage.objects.get, storage.objects.list, storage.objects.getIamPolicy).
jenna-custsec: logging follow-ups: make audit logs immutable for 90 days (WORM), add CI lint to block merges that add broad roles, and create nightly detection alert for objects missing kmsKeyName.
anil-sre: started rewrite jobs at 2109876900. progress update 2109876920: 2/3 objects rewritten to CMEK; last one hit transient 503, retrying with exponential backoff.
marta-s: opened INC-2026-512 and assigned owners: anil-sre -> re-encrypt + checksum validation, kai-infra -> RBAC rollback + role PR, jenna-custsec -> customer impact assessment and comms draft, oliver-md -> update incident runbook with CMEK-omission steps.
audit-bot: [note] 2109876935 detection rule created: backup_object_missing_kms -> alert to #eng-security-nightly.
anil-sre: final rewrite succeeded at 2109876948. verified checksums match original. no restores used these snapshots.
kai-infra: CI now enforces a policy file that denies diffs which add roles/storage.admin to service accounts without a review label.
jenna-custsec: drafting customer note: no customer restores affected, snapshots re-encrypted, root cause: deploy-bot rollout applied broader role during role composition change. will circulate postmortem once complete.
marta-s: postmortem action items: tighten deploy-bot guardrails, improve backup upload validation to reject missing kmsKeyName at ingestion, run quarterly KMS grant audit. closing incident once comms sent. :white_check_mark:
